0.0: Ugh... I'm so ashamed of this bloated form. Maybe if you take some of them out, I can change back? I have something to give you, but my body isn't listening.
0.1: Oh? You want to know how I can talk? It's because of you. Destroying those Dreamkeepers has weakened this place's hold on me.

1.0: Take this. It will help you.
1.1: I was going to sell it and retire someday... Oh, well.

yes.0: What I gave you is for reaching high places. It'll be useful where there are no ropes or ladders.
yes.1: Don't worry about it. Not like we're leaving anytime soon.
